title: 国际空间站：蛋白质晶体量产纪录，抗癌药能否因此实现居家注射？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Energy in space to medicine in space UK startup bio orbit is making a bold bet that by sending drug making towards the stars it can help save
segments.zh: 从太空能源到太空医药，英国初创公司BioOrbit大胆押注：将药物制造送入星空，有望拯救生命，并为NHS等医疗机构节省数十亿美元。

segments.en: Lives and billions of dollars potentially from health providers like the NHS and potentially pave the way for novel cancer treatments that are easier to use
segments.zh: 还可能为更易使用的新型癌症疗法铺平道路。

segments.en: The company has a lofty goal. It wants to harness weightlessness or microgravity to produce protein crystals that could pave the way for cancer treatments
segments.zh: 该公司目标宏大：利用微重力环境生产蛋白质晶体，为癌症治疗开辟新途径。

segments.en: That people can inject at home instead of receiving by IV in March bio orbit 1a 250 Thousand-pound contract from the UK Space Agency to develop the technology Katie King bio orbits co-found and CEO is with me now in the studio Katie
segments.zh: 让患者在家自行注射，而非去医院输液。三月，BioOrbit获得英国航天局25万英镑合同，开发该技术。联合创始人兼CEO Katie King来到演播室。

segments.en: Thank you for coming in when I was talking to people about what you do people who are not in your space in your sector Excuse the pun there was kind of a problem and wow that sounds like science fiction but you have come through with a really important proof point
segments.zh: Katie，感谢到来。当我和外人聊起你们的工作，他们觉得像科幻小说，但你们最近取得了重要进展。

segments.en: Just in the last few months talk us about the progress that you and the team have made Great. It's great to be here. Thank you for having me. It's a really exciting time for bio orbit
segments.zh: 请谈谈你们团队取得的进展。很高兴来到这里，对BioOrbit来说，这是激动人心的时刻。

segments.en: We just launched a record breaking mission to the space station producing the largest scale production of protein crystals in a space environment
segments.zh: 我们刚完成一项创纪录的任务，在国际空间站实现了最大规模的蛋白质晶体生产。

segments.en: By one order if not two orders of magnitude and this is a necessary stepping stone towards taking those cancer treatments and enabling them to be self-administered at home
segments.zh: 规模提升了一个甚至两个数量级，这是实现癌症治疗药物居家自我注射的关键一步。

segments.en: Why is this why is this so important and what can space allow you to do that we can't do back on earth So to get a self-administered cancer treatment you need to take all of that drug from that IV bag and get it into a small pen
segments.zh: 为什么这很重要？太空能实现哪些地球上做不到的事？要实现居家自我注射，需要将静脉输液袋中的药物浓缩到一支小笔中。
